M0: Unchanged historical q1 spectral/RMS reference, 75 parameters.
M1: Learned multiscale encoder; ordinary mean/max pooled linear classifier.
M2: Same encoder; mean background plus sparse signed additive evidence, learned stage-contrast top-K.
M3: Same encoder and background; local event decision path disabled.
M2_rms: Exactly M2 capacity and budget; rank by physical RMS instead of learned contrast.
M1_phase: Exactly M1 capacity; remove patch Fourier phase before encoding, retain full magnitude/mean/RMS.
fixed_encoder: M1/M2/M3 reuse byte-identical final M1 encoder weights, freeze them and reset heads; same 150-update head exposure.
M4: Omitted: no conditional availability mechanism is assumed necessary after previous negative results.
